title: apideck.com/blog/quickbooks-api-pricing-and-the-intuit-app-partner-program
snippet:
Intuit introduced a significant change in 2025 with the launch of the [Intuit App Partner Program](https://blogs.intuit.com/2025/05/15/introducing-the-intuit-app-partner-program/). This new program introduces a tiered pricing model that distinguishes between different types of API operations, offering free unlimited access for data creation and updates while implementing usage-based pricing for data retrieval operations.

**Important Note**: The Intuit App Partner Program and its associated pricing structure **only applies to QuickBooks Online (QBO)** integrations. If you're building integrations with the [QuickBooks Desktop API](https://www.apideck.com/blog/build-an-integration-with-quickbooks-desktop-in-2025), this pricing model does not apply to you.
This pricing information is specifically for:
- ✅ **QuickBooks Online API** (REST API)
- ❌ **QuickBooks Desktop/Enterprise**

### Builder Tier (Free)
- **Monthly Fee**: $0
- **Core API Calls**: Unlimited (free)
- **CorePlus API Credits**: 500,000 per month
- **Overage**: API calls are **blocked** after exceeding the 500,000 limit
- **Premium API Access**: Not included
- **Best For**: Small developers and those just getting started
### Silver Tier
- **Monthly Fee**: $300
- **Core API Calls**: Unlimited (free)
- **CorePlus API Credits**: 1 million per month (~$3,500 worth)
- **Overage Rate**: $3.50 per 1,000 API calls
- **Premium API Access**: Yes - Projects, Custom Fields, Sales Tax, Time with Payroll
- **Best For**: Growing applications with moderate data retrieval needs
### Gold Tier
- **Monthly Fee**: $1,700
- **Core API Calls**: Unlimited (free)
- **CorePlus API Credits**: Higher allocation than Silver
- **Overage Rate**: Better rates than Silver tier
- **Premium API Access**: Yes - Projects, Custom Fields, Sales Tax, Time with Payroll
- **Additional Benefits**: Allocated partner team, improved support
### Platinum Tier
- **Monthly Fee**: $4,500
- **Core API Calls**: Unlimited (free)
- **CorePlus API Credits**: Up to 75 million per month (~$18,750 worth)
- **Overage Rate**: $0.25 per 1,000 API calls (best available rate)
- **Premium API Access**: Yes - Projects, Custom Fields, Sales Tax, Time with Payroll
- **Additional Benefits**: Premium support, early access to new features
## Premium APIs

title: Can you provide QuickBooks API access for historical client data to build our internal dashboard, including any API limits, restrictions, and charges? | QuickBooks Community
snippet:
Whether API access is available under our existing QuickBooks Online subscription or requires a separate developer/commercial arrangement.

Yes, you can pull historical accounting and transaction data into your dashboard through the QuickBooks Online Accounting API, and setting up developer access itself is free. Here's how each piece works.
### Getting API access
1. Create a free account at the [Intuit Developer Portal](https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/get-started/start-developing-your-app), separate from your regular QuickBooks Online login.
2. From your developer dashboard, create an app and select QuickBooks Online. This generates your client ID and client secret, plus a free sandbox company for testing.
3. Each of your clients' QuickBooks Online companies will need to individually connect and authorize your app through OAuth 2.0, since access is scoped per company (per "realm ID"). There's no single connection that pulls data across all your managed clients at once, so each client authorizes the connection to their own books.

API access itself runs on a separate track from your QuickBooks Online subscription, through Intuit's App Partner Program. As of this program's rollout, API calls are split into two types:
- **Core calls** (mostly creating or updating records) are free and unmetered on every tier.
- **CorePlus calls** (mostly reading data and pulling reports, which is what your dashboard would rely on) are metered. The free Builder tier includes 500,000 CorePlus calls per month at no cost. Beyond that, paid tiers (Silver, Gold, Platinum) add higher monthly credit allotments with per-call overage pricing.
For a reporting dashboard like yours, you'd likely start on the free Builder tier and only need to consider a paid tier if your combined client data volume pushes past that monthly CorePlus allowance.
Full tier and pricing details can be found here: [Intuit App Partner Program Guide](https://static.developer.intuit.com/resources/Intuit_App_Partner_Program_Guide.pdf)

title: Intuit App Partner Program FAQ
snippet:
The Intuit App Partner Program is a transformative update to our platform, designed to accommodate partners of all sizes with different levels of engagement. It provides four distinct partner tiers, with a set of benefits tailored to different levels of engagement. The program features an improved developer experience, access to premium APIs, go-to-market support, and the implementation of platform service fees.*

**What’s the difference between the QuickBooks Solution Provider program and the Intuit App Partner Program?**
The Intuit App Partner Program and the Intuit QuickBooks Solution Provider (QSP) program are two separate programs that provide unique benefits and features. If you are both an Intuit QuickBooks Solution Provider and an Intuit App Developer, contact your QSP representative at Intuit to learn how these programs compare.

- **Active connections:** Defined as individual Intuit QuickBooks Online or Intuit Enterprise Suite companies that have an active subscription and a valid, non-expired OAuth token.

The App Partner Program includes access to several useful premium APIs, providing you with richer functionality and deeper integration with Intuit QuickBooks Online and Intuit Enterprise Suite: Projects API, Custom Fields API, Sales Tax API, Intuit QuickBooks Workforce API, and Dimensions API.

As part of the program*, you’ll gain access to the Intuit Partner Resource Center (PRC) to assist with your QuickBooks marketing initiatives. Access to specific features and benefits is determined by your partner tier. PRC access is now fully automated and updates in near real-time. Whether you subscribe, upgrade, downgrade, or cancel, your permissions are adjusted automatically without the need for support tickets. Partners in the Silver, Gold, and Platinum tiers can seamlessly access enablement content, playbooks, and co-marketing assets specific to their level.
